name: Paramo
notes: High-Andean paramo (Colombia, Venezuela, Ecuador, N Peru) above cloud forest: humid, giant-rosette frailejones, tussock grasses, cushion bogs and dwarf shrubs; Espeletia in the north, Puya and Chusquea widespread.

shrub.name: Frailejon
shrub.source: Espeletia grandiflora, Colombian Eastern Cordillera paramo 2700-4200 m, woolly stem-rosette 0.5-3 m with yellow daisies

shrub.name: Tall frailejon
shrub.source: Espeletia pycnophylla, Ecuador/S Colombia paramo (El Angel), columnar stem-rosette to 6 m, dense stands

shrub.name: Paramo dwarf shrub
shrub.source: Hypericum laricifolium, Venezuela to Peru paramo 2800-4300 m, heath-like needle-leaved shrub 0.5-2 m, yellow flowers

shrub.name: Paramo dwarf bamboo
shrub.source: Chusquea tessellata, Colombia/Venezuela/Ecuador wet paramo 3000-4300 m, dwarf bamboo thickets 0.5-2 m

shrub.name: Paramo puya
shrub.source: Puya clava-herculis, Ecuadorian paramo 3300-4400 m, spiny terrestrial bromeliad rosette 1-2.5 m with blue-green spike

ground.name: Tussock grass
ground.source: Calamagrostis effusa, dominant bunchgrass of Colombian/Venezuelan grass paramo 2800-4300 m, tussocks 40-100 cm

ground.name: Cushion plant
ground.source: Plantago rigida, Andean cushion bogs Venezuela to Bolivia 3500-4800 m, hard mounded cushions 5-30 cm

ground.name: Bog moss
ground.source: Sphagnum magellanicum, Andean paramo bogs and southern S America, red peat moss carpets

ground.name: Paramo lupine
ground.source: Lupinus alopecuroides, superparamo Colombia/Ecuador 3800-4800 m, woolly rosette with blue flower spike

ground.name: Paramo club moss
ground.source: Lycopodium clavatum, cosmopolitan incl. Andean paramo, trailing club moss 5-20 cm

special.note: Catalogue plants (data/plants) whose band centres fall inside this biome's climate; computed, informational. Phase 6 may raise their density here so they are findable.

associations.name: Frailejon-tussock grass paramo
associations.where: open humid slopes and rolling plateaus above treeline, well-drained peaty soil
associations.source: Cuatrecasas 1968 Paramo vegetation and its life forms; Cleef 1981 Vegetation of the paramos of the Colombian Cordillera Oriental

associations.name: Tall frailejon subparamo
associations.where: sheltered lower paramo just above the cloud forest edge, deeper soil

associations.name: Cushion bog (paramo turbera)
associations.where: flat valley floors, hollows and lake margins with waterlogged peat
associations.source: Cleef 1981; Bosman et al. 1993 Paramo cushion bogs of Colombia (Vegetatio)

associations.name: Puya-dwarf shrub rocky paramo
associations.where: rocky ridges, cliffs and dry exposed slopes with thin soil
associations.source: Cuatrecasas 1968; Luteyn 1999 Paramos: a checklist of plant diversity, geographical distribution and botanical literature

associations.name: Tussock grass paramo grassland
associations.where: wide open slopes and burned or grazed flats, drier and wind-exposed
associations.source: Hofstede 1995 Effects of burning and grazing on a Colombian paramo ecosystem; Cleef 1981
